common.gcode_not_sent: This G-code is only shown: the page does not send it to the machine.

reasons.no_axes: The axes of the machine were not read
reasons.non_cartesian_kinematics: Non cartesian kinematics: not supported yet

reasons.noZ: The machine has no Z axis

page.lead: Check, calibrate and look after the machine: probe, levelling, mesh, offsets, limits and maintenance.
page.read_only: Read only: your role can see the results but cannot start procedures.
page.viewer_only: Your role sees the overview. Identify yourself as operator or technician to see the modules.
page.stop_hint: Stops the procedure at the end of its current step. It is not the emergency stop.
page.unavailable_title: Modules not available on this machine

overview.title: Calibrations
overview.no_data: No data to show right now.
overview.old_after: It is considered old after {days} days.
overview.no_live: No connection to the board: the data may be out of date.

run.stopping_hint: It stops at the end of the current step and the probe retracts by itself.
run.another_running: Another procedure is running ({kind}): wait for it to end or stop it.
run.error_machine_halted: The machine halted: the procedure ended.
run.error_reservation_lost: The movement reservation was lost: someone else took it.
run.error_reserved: The movement is reserved by someone else.
run.error_forbidden_code: The service refused to send a code that is not allowed.
run.error_bad_reply: The board answered something that could not be read.
run.refuse_not_homed: Some axes are not homed: home first.
run.refuse_unsupported_kinematics: The kinematics of this machine is not supported.
run.refuse_no_model: There is no model of the board yet.
run.refuse_motion_denied: The movement is not free now (a job is running or it is reserved).
run.refuse_not_implemented: The service does not include this procedure yet.
run.refuse_forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
run.refuse_other: The procedure could not be started.
run.check_probe: The probe is connected and free
run.check_clear: There is free space under the head and above the bed
run.check_estop: The emergency stop is within reach
run.check_bed: Nothing on the bed that the probe could hit
run.needs_technician: Starting procedures needs the technician role.
run.refuse_no_vision_measure: The camera cannot measure on this machine.
run.refuse_tool_not_current: That tool is not the active one: the run never changes tool.
run.refuse_bad_target: The system or tool is not valid.
run.refuse_out_of_reach: The point is outside the limits of X or Y.
run.error_vision_not_found: The camera did not find the mark or the head.
run.error_vision_bad_answer: Vision answered something that cannot be trusted.

probe.title: Probe repeatability
probe.intro: Touches the same point several times and measures how much the height varies. A good probe repeats within hundredths of a millimetre.
probe.verdict_bad: Does not repeat: check the probe
probe.thresholds: Verdict: good up to {warn} mm, bad above {bad} mm standard deviation.
probe.no_result: There is no measurement yet. Start the test.

level.title: Bed levelling
level.intro: Measures the bed with the probe and, with several Z motors and M671, corrects it in passes until it is within tolerance.
level.mode_missingM671: Several Z motors without a complete M671
level.reason_missingM671: Only measuring is possible: M671 is missing to correct.
level.reason_singleZ: One Z motor: only measuring is possible.
level.reason_noZ: There is no Z axis: there is nothing to level.
level.reason_unknown: The levelling mode has not been detected yet (the configuration was not read).
level.trend_converged: Converged: the bed is within tolerance.
level.trend_diverging: Diverging: the last pass got worse. Check M671 and the leadscrew positions.
level.no_result: There is no levelling yet. Choose what to do and start.

mesh.title: Height map
mesh.intro: Measures the height of the bed on a grid, saves it and applies it as compensation.
mesh.locked_by_points: The counts and the region come from the points chosen on the bed: {nx} x {ny} nodes, X {x0} to {x1}, Y {y0} to {y1} mm. Change them on the bed.
mesh.err_region: The region needs minimums below maximums and must be inside the bed.
mesh.err_taper: The taper height is a whole number between 0 and 50 mm.
mesh.err_name: Name of 1 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore.
mesh.map_empty: There is no mesh to show. Probe one or load one from the library.
mesh.tolerance_hint: Cells outside the tolerance from the mean get a dashed outline.
mesh.taper_hint: Height at which the compensation fades out; 0 keeps it the same at every height.
mesh.read_only: Loading, clearing, saving and taper need the technician role.
mesh.open_height_map: Open in the DWC Height Map (3D)
mesh.err_grid: The mesh could not be read.
mesh.no_service_meshes: The service does not include the mesh library yet.

history.title: Calibration history
history.intro: Every calibration is recorded with who made it and when. Compare two records of the same kind or restore earlier values: restoring only prepares a plan that you review before applying it.
history.empty: There are no records with these filters.
history.compare_hint: Tick two records of the same kind to compare them.
history.diff_cut: There are more differences than shown.
history.err_kind_mismatch: Only records of the same kind can be compared.
history.err_mesh_grid_differs: The maps do not have the same points: they cannot be subtracted.
history.err_mesh_mesh_missing: One of the maps is missing: it was deleted from the library.
history.err_mesh_unreadable: One of the maps could not be read.
history.reason_not_restorable: This kind of record cannot be restored.
history.reason_not_applied: This record did not change any file.
history.reason_no_value: The line did not exist before: there is no value to restore.

plan.conflict_intro: A file on the SD changed since the record was made. Look at the three-column table and, if you accept the current state, continue.
plan.conflict_accept: I accept the current state of the SD as the starting point
plan.conflict_continue: Prepare the plan with the current state
plan.three_way: What the record had and what the file has now
plan.diff_cut: The change is longer: only the first lines are shown.
plan.admin_only: Only an administrator applies this change.
plan.nothing: There are no changes to apply.
plan.done_restart: The board needs a restart for everything to take effect.
plan.err_plan_expired: The plan expired: prepare it again.
plan.err_kind_mismatch: The plan is not for this kind of change.
plan.err_role: Your role does not allow applying this change.
plan.err_busy_run: A procedure is running: wait for it to end.
plan.err_nothing_to_apply: Nothing to apply: the values are already the current ones.
plan.err_conflict: A file changed on the SD since the plan was prepared: prepare it again.
plan.err_no_config: The configuration file was not found.
plan.err_not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 and cannot be edited.
plan.err_out_of_reach: A point is outside the reach of the probe.
plan.err_no_limits: The M208 limits were not found in the configuration.
plan.err_not_implemented: The service does not include this change yet.
plan.err_invalid_args: The service did not accept the data.
plan.err_forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
plan.err_motion_denied: The movement is not free (a job is running or someone reserved it).
plan.err_file_changed: The file on the SD changed since the record was made.
plan.err_other: The operation could not be completed.
plan.err_patch_missing_line: The line to change does not exist in the configuration: the service does not invent it.
plan.err_patch_unsupported_form: The line in the configuration has a form the service does not rewrite.
plan.err_patch_expression: The value in the configuration is an expression: it is not replaced.
plan.err_current_over_limit: The current is above the safety limit of the machine profile.
plan.err_bad_type: The type is not one that can be set.
plan.err_out_of_range: The correction is outside the accepted range (between half and double): check the measurements.
plan.err_implausible: The measurements are not plausible (skew above 3 degrees or diagonals that do not match): check the measurements.
plan.err_no_value: A value to compute is missing.
plan.warn_no_anchor: The line has no anchor in the file: it is added at the end.
plan.warn_several_definitions: The line is defined several times: the last one is changed.
plan.warn_multi_driver_value: The value has several drivers: check which one changes.
plan.warn_no_m558_for_probe: There is no probe M558: the line is added at the end.
plan.warn_no_m558: There is no M558 in the configuration: the line is added at the end.
plan.warn_defined_in_several_files: The value is defined in more than one file: all of them change.
plan.warn_nothing_changes: This change does not modify anything.
plan.warn_new_line_resets_defaults: A new line starts from the firmware factory values for what is not given.
plan.warn_big_change: The change is big: repeat the measurement before applying.
plan.warn_also_in_config: The offsets are also written in config.g: they stay duplicated.
plan.warn_config_calls_macro: The call to the offsets macro (M98) is added to config.g so they load at start-up.
plan.warn_custom_shaper_replaced: A custom ringing filter is replaced.
plan.warn_several_m671: There are several M671 in the configuration: the last one is changed.
plan.warn_no_m584: No M584 found for the Z motors.
plan.warn_g28z_removed: The G28 Z was removed from the levelling file.
plan.warn_no_loop: The levelling file has no loop: a new one is written.
plan.warn_entries_differ_from_z_motors: The M671 entries do not match the Z motors of M584.
plan.warn_structure: The structure of the file is not recognised.

report.title: Printable report
report.intro: One page per calibration or the full machine status report, with a signature line. Print it or save it as PDF from the browser.
report.print_hint: In the print dialog choose "Save as PDF" if you want a file.
report.level_ok: The bed ended within the tolerance.
report.level_warn: The bed ended outside the tolerance.

safety.title: Safety check
safety.intro: Checks the machine in one go and says what to fix. It only reads: nothing moves. Anything that needs motion is done in its own module.
safety.d_reach: probe reach: X from {xmin} to {xmax} mm, Y from {ymin} to {ymax} mm
safety.reason_configuration_not_read: the levelling configuration could not be read
safety.reason_no_limits: the axis limits are not known
safety.reason_probe_cannot_reach_the_bed: the probe cannot reach the bed with these limits
safety.reason_no_verified_key: the firmware does not publish the reason of the last reset; it only appears in the reply of M122
safety.reason_no_vin: the board reports no input voltage
safety.reason_no_profile: there is no machine profile with interlocks yet
safety.reason_not_declared: no interlocks are declared in the machine profile
safety.reason_no_guard_state: the state of the configuration guard could not be read
safety.not_run: The machine has not been checked yet.
safety.item_reach: M208 limits against the probe reach
safety.action_open_levelling: Check the Levelling module: M671 needs one entry per Z motor.
safety.action_check_probe: Check the probe connection and trigger (Probe module).
safety.action_check_probe_offsets: Check the probe offsets: they cannot exceed the bed size (Probe module).
safety.action_check_limits: Adjust the limits or the mesh area so the probe reaches the bed (Limits module).
safety.action_see_heaters: Check the thermistor and the heater with the fault.
safety.action_see_sensors: Check the sensors that do not answer.
safety.action_reset_board: Restart the board to clear the state.
safety.action_fix_startup_error: Fix the startup error the board shows.
safety.action_check_supply: Check the power supply and the wiring.
safety.action_close_interlocks: Close the lid and check the laser interlocks.
safety.action_declare_interlocks: Declare the laser interlocks in the machine profile.
safety.action_check_config_guard: Check why the configuration guard is armed or locked.
safety.action_kinematics_unsupported: This kinematics is not supported: do not use the levelling modules.

offsets.title: Tool and work offsets
offsets.intro: The offset of each tool and the work coordinate systems G54 to G59.3. To keep them, a configuration change is prepared with a preview.
offsets.read_only: Read only: editing offsets needs the technician role.
offsets.one_tool: Tools are saved one at a time: each row has its own button.
offsets.no_work: The board reports no work systems.
offsets.err_value: A value is not a valid number (1000 mm at most).
offsets.persist_hint: The board keeps these offsets in memory only. Here they are written as a G10 block in the configuration, with a preview and a backup.
offsets.target_macro: In a macro of its own (workshop-offsets.g)
offsets.target_config: In the file that already has the G10 L2 lines
offsets.taken_diff: Snapshot saved: {n} values differ from the previous one.
offsets.taken_first: Snapshot saved: it is the first.
offsets.restore_hint: To go back to a snapshot open it in the History and restore it: the change is shown before anything is written.
offsets.pointer_intro: Aligns the pointer (tool {pointer}) with the laser (tool {laser}).
offsets.pointer_step_1: 1. Mark a cross with the laser at low power.
offsets.pointer_step_2: 2. Bring the pointer to the centre of the cross with the Jog and ask for the capture.
offsets.pointer_guard: The service caps the power at {max} % and requires laser mode, homed axes and closed interlocks.
offsets.pointer_marked: Cross marked with the head at X {x}, Y {y}.
offsets.pointer_saved: Saved for the Jog and the work table.
offsets.pointer_not_saved: Not saved: it is only a reading.
offsets.pointer_sign: The service computes the correction as the head position when marking minus the one now. Its sign is not verified on a machine.
offsets.cross_bad_power: The power must be between 1 and 10 %.
offsets.cross_no_model: There is no model of the board yet.
offsets.cross_not_laser_mode: The machine is not in laser mode.
offsets.cross_not_homed: The X and Y axes are not homed.
offsets.cross_busy_mark: A mark is already in progress.
offsets.cross_no_mark: There is no cross marked: mark one first.
offsets.cross_no_position: The head position could not be read.
offsets.cross_forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
offsets.cross_other: The operation could not be completed.

height.title: Tool height
height.intro: How the height of each mode is measured, the BLTouch trigger height, the fine adjustment and the paper. It applies to every zone.
height.read_only: Read only: calibrating the height needs the technician role.
height.card_title: Calibrate the height in {mode} (applies to every zone)
height.not_current: The machine is not in {mode} mode now: you can change the fine adjustment and the method, but the probe measurements are only made in the active mode.
height.note_bltouch: BLTouch: it measures the surface at the Z point. Its trigger height (G31 Z) is one per mode; if the tool ends up too high or too low, use the fine adjustment.
height.note_paper: Paper: no probe. You take the tool to the point, lower it until it brushes a sheet and the height is set there.
height.note_szp: SZP (Duet scanning Z probe, FFF only): calibrates the drive level and the height against the reading.
height.from_mode_file: the one of the mode file
height.adjust_tip: Positive = the tool ends up further from the surface. It applies to every zone of the mode.
height.err_adjust: The adjustment must be between -3 and 3 mm.
height.err_paper: The thickness must be between 0 and 3 mm.
height.block_not_current: The machine has to be in {mode} mode to measure.
height.block_macro_missing: The calibration macros are missing on the card (zcal-*.g, installed by the Workbench plugin).
height.block_no_probe: The machine has no probe in this mode.
height.block_no_szp: There is no probe K1 (SZP) in this mode.
height.hook_missing: The mode files {files} do not load the calibration when the mode changes yet.
height.hook_tip: Adds an M98 line at the end of each mode file (a copy of the original is kept).
height.hook_done: Done: mode files updated ({files}). A copy of each was kept.
height.conflict: The calibration changed while you were editing it: it was read again, check the values and save once more.
height.not_applied_now: (it will apply on the next mode change: a job is running now or the board is not connected)
height.err_szp: S must be between 1 and 31 and R must be a whole number.
height.paper_marked: Z set with the paper: the tool rises to 5 mm.
height.wizard_paper_title: Measure the height with paper in {mode}
height.step_goto: Bring the tool over the point X {x} Y {y}.
height.step_lower: Lower it in small steps until it brushes the paper (Z now: {z}).
height.step_measure: The probe measures at the same point.
height.point_clamped: The point was moved inside the travel of the machine.
height.mark_k0: It brushes the paper: mark Z0 and rise
height.mark_paper: It brushes the paper: set Z with a {paper} mm paper
height.measured_text: It triggered at {med} mm (before {prev} mm). It is saved as the G31 Z of {mode}.
height.shift_warning: It changes by {d} mm: check the paper before saving.
height.szp_tip: With Z0 on the bed and the axes homed, it puts the SZP over the point and calibrates.

limits.title: Axis limits
limits.intro: The soft limits (M208) of each axis and the endstop verification.
limits.read_only: Read only: changing the limits needs the administrator role.
limits.config_unread: The configuration could not be read: only the board values are shown.
limits.warn_bad_limits: The limits of this axis are not consistent.
limits.err_number: Type two numbers in millimetres (up to 5000).
limits.err_order: The minimum must be below the maximum.
limits.admin_hint: Wrong limits can crash the machine: only an administrator changes them, with a preview.
limits.verify_intro: Homes the axes (it moves them) and checks that each endstop was free before and that the axis ended where it should.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.intro: Assistants for steps per mm, squareness and backlash. Each one shows its sum, the service does the final calculation and the result is sent as a plan that is reviewed before applying.
calibration.read_only: Read only: preparing and applying changes needs the technician role.
calibration.motors_link: If a motor loses steps or the driver complains, look at the Motors page: here only measurements are calibrated.
calibration.err_no_current: The current steps per mm of this axis is not known.
calibration.err_positive: Type every value as a number above zero.
calibration.err_commanded: The commanded move must be between 1 and 5000 mm.
calibration.err_ratio: The change is too big (more than double or less than half): check the measurements.
calibration.err_side: The side of the square must be between 10 and 1000 mm.
calibration.err_diagonal: The diagonals do not match a square of that side: check the measurements.
calibration.err_implausible: A skew above 3 degrees is not plausible: check the measurements or fix the mechanics.
calibration.err_entry: Each row needs both readings, or to be empty.
calibration.err_sample: Each measurement must be between 0 and 2 mm, with at most 20 rows.
calibration.err_multiplier: The multiplier must be between 1 and 100.
calibration.steps_intro: Command a move of a known length, measure what the axis really travelled and the new value comes from the formula.
calibration.steps_admin: Changing steps per mm (M92) needs the administrator role. You can compute the value but not apply it.
calibration.steps_test: Test move (run it yourself, with the axis free)
calibration.steps_big: The change is above 10 %: repeat the measurement to confirm it before applying.
calibration.steps_hint: The M92 line is written in the configuration, with a backup copy.
calibration.steps_plan: Steps per mm: review before applying
calibration.skew_intro: Draw a square with its two diagonals, measure the diagonals and their difference gives the skew between the two axes.
calibration.skew_d1: Diagonal from the origin to the opposite corner
calibration.skew_big: The skew is above 1 degree: fix the mechanics first (loose axes, twisted frame) and then compensate what is left.
calibration.skew_sign: Not verified on a real machine: repeat the square after applying and check that the diagonals become equal. If it gets worse, the sign is the other way round.
calibration.skew_hint: The M556 line is written in the configuration, with a backup copy.
calibration.backlash_intro: Bring the axis to a point from one side and from the other, write down the real position it reaches each time (with a dial gauge, for example) and repeat several times.
calibration.backlash_fixed: The M425 compensation is for FIXED backlash (couplings, nuts, pulleys). It does not fix belt stretch, which changes with speed and load.
calibration.backlash_stats: {n} measurement(s): mean {mean} mm, deviation {stdev} mm, minimum {min} mm, maximum {max} mm
calibration.warn_large_correction: The correction is above 10 %: repeat the measurement before applying.
calibration.warn_microstepping_note: M92 is microsteps per mm of the current M350: if you change the microstepping, this value changes with it.
calibration.warn_fixed_backlash_only: M425 is for fixed backlash only, not for belt stretch or flex.
calibration.warn_inconsistent: The measurements differ a lot from each other: the play is not constant (it may be belt stretch or a loose part). Compensating will not fix it.
calibration.warn_big_backlash: The backlash is above 0.5 mm: it is a mechanical fault worth fixing before compensating.
calibration.warn_per_motor: On CoreXY or other kinematics M425 is per MOTOR, not per axis: check the result.
calibration.warn_zero: The proposed value is zero: there would be nothing to compensate.
calibration.warn_not_in_g32: M425 is not applied to the levelling moves (G32).
calibration.warn_below_minimum: The frequency is below 4 Hz: check the count of ripples.
calibration.warn_very_high: The frequency is above 200 Hz: check the count of ripples.

motion.title: Motion parameters
motion.intro: Current, microstepping, speed, acceleration and jerk of each axis and extruder, as the board reports them.
motion.read_only: Read only: changing these parameters needs the administrator role.
motion.config_unread: The configuration could not be read: the driver mode may be missing.
motion.units: Current in mA, percentages in %, speed and jerk (M566) in mm/min, acceleration in mm/s², printing jerk (M205) in mm/s. A dash is a value the board does not report. * = interpolated, or default mode (the configuration does not set it).
motion.motors_question: Does a driver complain or does the motor lose steps?
motion.edit_intro: One parameter is changed at a time: the plan is prepared, the change in the file is reviewed and only then applied. Nothing is ever written to the driver directly.
motion.current_warn: More current heats the motor and the driver. Raise it little by little and watch the temperature. Profile cap: {max} mA.
motion.mode_hint: The mode is changed per driver, only if the M569 line already exists, and takes effect when the board restarts.
motion.admin_hint: Only an administrator changes these parameters.
motion.no_trial: This parameter cannot be tried without saving: it takes effect when the board restarts.
motion.mode_default: Default mode: the configuration does not set it
motion.err_choice: Choose one of the values in the list.

shaping.title: Input shaping
shaping.intro: Reduces vibration (ringing) after direction changes by filtering the motion with a resonance frequency of the machine (M593).
shaping.read_only: Read only: changing input shaping needs the technician role.
shaping.not_reported: The board does not report input shaping (firmware without support or not configured).
shaping.current_values: Type {type}, frequency {frequency} Hz, damping {damping}, minimum acceleration {accel} mm/s²
shaping.warn_retune_pressure_advance: With input shaping active it is worth tuning the pressure advance again.
shaping.warn_custom_shaper: The shaper is of the custom type: it is shown but not edited here, and cannot be put back by a trial.
shaping.min_accel_note: The minimum acceleration is shown as the board reports it; it is not edited from here.
shaping.tech_hint: The M593 line is written in the configuration, with a backup copy.
shaping.err_type: Choose a type from the list.
shaping.err_frequency: The frequency must be between {min} and 250 Hz.
shaping.err_damping: The damping must be a number from 0 up to below 1.
shaping.tuner_none: This machine has no accelerometer, so the frequency cannot be measured automatically. Use the ringing test below: print or mark the pattern, count the ripples and compute the frequency.
shaping.tuner_intro: The board reports {count} accelerometer(s). The collection moves the axis and saves the samples in a file (M955 and M956 on the service).
shaping.tuner_declared: The accelerometer is only declared in the profile, the board does not list it: the service will refuse the collection.
shaping.tuner_next: The service only collects the data: it does not compute the frequency. Read it from the data with the tool you prefer and type it in the form above.
shaping.ringing_intro: The service generates G-code of short strokes with abrupt stops at different accelerations. It is shown so you copy it and run it yourself as a job with the machine free: the page does not send it.
shaping.ringing_needs_technician: Generating the G-code needs the technician role.
shaping.ringing_measure: After the test: count the ripples
shaping.ringing_no_freq: Type the ripples and the distance to compute the frequency.
shaping.err_ringing: Type speed, ripples and distance above zero.
shaping.err_ripples: The ripples must be a whole number between 2 and 200.

try.title: Try now
try.intro: Applies the value only for a while, without saving it. If you do not press Keep, the service puts the previous value back by itself.
try.running: Trial of {kind} running: it reverts by itself in {seconds} s.
try.keep_hint: Keep leaves the value active until the next start; afterwards you can prepare it as a permanent change.
try.needs_role: Your role does not allow trying this value.
try.done_kept: Value kept until the next start.
try.done_reverted: The previous value was put back.
try.done_expired: Time is over: the service put the previous value back.
try.err_try_pending: A trial is already running: end it first.
try.err_busy_run: A procedure is running: wait for it to end.
try.err_no_previous: The current value could not be read: nothing is tried without a way back.
try.err_not_found: The trial no longer exists (it may have ended).
try.err_revert_failed: The previous value could not be put back: check the machine.
try.err_job_running: A job is running: no values are tried now.
try.err_other: The operation could not be completed.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.intro: Hours and distance are counted by the service, not by the board. The plan lists what to service and when; mark an item as done when you do it.
maintenance.estimated_note: The distance is ESTIMATED from sampled positions and is always a little below the real one. Power-on hours count while the machine is powered and the motor is not released; movement hours count while the axis moves.
maintenance.needs_technician: Marking an item as done and editing the plan need the technician role.
maintenance.no_history: Nothing has been marked as done yet.
maintenance.notify_on: A phone notice is sent when an item becomes due.
maintenance.notify_off: No phone notice when an item becomes due.
maintenance.not_counting: The service is not counting now (the Machine module is stopped or has no data).
maintenance.gaps: The service skipped {gaps} gap(s) in the data and {jumps} implausible jump(s) instead of counting them.
maintenance.cross_ok: Cross-check with the last job: estimated / planned path = {ratio} (as expected).
maintenance.cross_low: Cross-check with the last job: estimated / planned path = {ratio}: the sampling misses part of the movement.
maintenance.cross_high: Cross-check with the last job: estimated / planned path = {ratio}: more than planned, check the file or the noise.
maintenance.field_notify: Send a phone notice when an item becomes due
maintenance.err_id: The code needs lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter.
maintenance.err_label: A name of up to 80 characters is needed.
maintenance.err_value: A number from 0.01 to 1000000 is needed.
maintenance.err_too_many: The plan has too many items.

verify.title: Verification with the camera
verify.intro: The camera measures where the head or a mark really is and compares it with where the offset says it should be.
verify.manual: The camera cannot measure on this machine (Vision does not offer vision.measure), so the verification is manual: mark a point at each offset and measure the difference with a ruler or a calibrated eye.
verify.moves_note: The machine moves while this runs; a laser mark is fired only with the laser method.
verify.system_note: Goes to the work origin of the system and compares it with what the camera sees there.
verify.tool_note: Uses the tool that is active now (the run never changes tool): its tip should land on the work origin of the current system.
verify.no_rows: No verification has been made yet.
verify.table_note: The latest result of each system or tool. The error is the distance between the measured and the expected point; the uncertainty is twice the camera's sigma.
verify.last_out: Out of tolerance: the offset does not point where the camera sees it.
verify.last_inconclusive: Inconclusive: the camera is not precise enough to decide. Improve its calibration or raise the tolerance.

bed.smaller_tip: Shrinks the region 10 mm on every side
bed.bigger_tip: Grows the region 10 mm on every side
bed.offset_label: Head to probe: X {x}, Y {y} mm
bed.scale_tip: The line next to it is {mm} mm long in real life on this map: use it to judge distances. It is not a limit or a setting.
bed.detail_empty: Tap a point on the bed to see it here.
bed.reason_outside_bed: The point is outside the axis limits of the bed.
bed.reason_screw_outside_reach: The leadscrew is outside the probe reach: the nearest reachable point is used.
bed.reason_reach_unknown: The probe reach is not known, so this point cannot be checked.
bed.reason_other: The service gave another reason for this point.
bed.resize_invalid: That value is not a number: the previous one was kept.
bed.resize_beyond_bed: The value was kept inside the machine travel.
bed.resize_too_small: The area cannot be smaller than 10 mm per side: it was adjusted.
bed.resize_beyond_reach: Part of the area is beyond what the probe reaches: the run measures only up to its reach (see the marked zone).
bed.resize_needs_points: Choose at least two points that make a mesh to resize it here.
bed.edit_area_tip: Back to the plan with the area of this mesh to make it bigger or smaller
bed.preset_unavailable: Not available: the data it needs is not known.
bed.compare_no_previous: There is no previous mesh to compare with.
bed.compare_grid_differs: The previous mesh has other points.
bed.mesh_summary: {points} points will be measured, {clipped} are inside the safety margin of the reach and {outside} are outside the reach.
bed.source_local: Points computed on this page (the service has not confirmed them).
bed.no_bed: The bed size is not known, so it cannot be drawn.
bed.mesh_help: Drag the rectangle or its handles to set the region (the fields below follow). With the keyboard: Tab to a handle, arrows to move it, Shift for bigger steps.
bed.missing_no_probe: No probe is configured: nothing can be measured.
bed.missing_no_reach: The probe reach is not known.
bed.missing_no_m671: M671 is not defined: the leadscrews cannot be placed.
bed.missing_layout_unavailable: The service does not answer the machine layout: only what DWC reports is drawn.
bed.level_help: Drag a point to move it inside the probe reach. Tap it for its detail.
bed.level_label: Bed with the leadscrews and the measurement points
bed.level_preview_note: The points you edited are a preview: a run still measures the points the service chooses.
bed.issue_too_few: There are {have} points and at least {need} are needed.
bed.issue_not_measurable: {count} points cannot be measured (outside the probe reach).
bed.issue_collinear: The points are on a line: they cannot tell the tilt of the bed.
bed.issue_screw_uncovered: No point is nearest to the leadscrew(s) {screws}: they could not be corrected.
bed.reason_head_outside_x: The point is on the bed but the head would leave its X limits to put the probe there (the probe is offset from the nozzle).
bed.reason_head_outside_y: The point is on the bed but the head would leave its Y limits to put the probe there (the probe is offset from the nozzle).
bed.reason_head_outside_xy: The point is on the bed but the head would leave its X and Y limits to put the probe there (the probe is offset from the nozzle).
bed.reason_inside_margin: The point is reachable but closer to the edge of the reach than the safety margin the run keeps, so the run clips the region.
bed.reason_no_limits: The axis limits are not known, so this point cannot be judged.
bed.reason_no_probe: There is no probe, so this point cannot be judged.
bed.reason_unsupported_kinematics: This kinematics is not supported by the geometry check, so this point cannot be judged.
bed.reason_duplicate_point: Another point is less than 1 mm from this one.
bed.missing_no_bed: The axis limits are not known (neither the service nor DWC reports them).
bed.missing_empty_reach: The probe cannot reach any point of the bed with this offset.
bed.missing_unsupported_kinematics: This kinematics is not supported by the geometry check: the reach and the points are not judged.
bed.missing_m671_unreadable: M671 could not be read from the configuration.
bed.too_many: The grid has more points than a run accepts. Use fewer points.
bed.issue_no_probe: There is no probe: nothing can be measured.
bed.issue_no_points: There are no points to measure.
bed.issue_too_many_points: There are more points than a run accepts.
bed.issue_no_limits: The axis limits are not known, so the points cannot be checked.
bed.issue_out_of_reach: Point {point} cannot be reached by the probe.
bed.issue_duplicate_point: Point {point} is less than 1 mm from an earlier one.
bed.issue_descent: The probe would have to go down {bound} mm and the safety limit is {limit} mm.
bed.issue_other: The service refused the points for another reason.
bed.probe_label: Bed with the probe reach and offset
bed.probe_offset: The probe sits at X {x}, Y {y} mm from the nozzle (the dashed rectangle is where the probe can measure).
bed.tab_plan_sub: What I am going to measure
bed.tab_result_none: No result yet: run a mesh, or pick one from the library below.
bed.tabs_hint: The bed has two views. PLAN shows the points the next run will measure and lets you change them. RESULT shows the heights the last run measured. Switch with the two tabs above the bed.
bed.mode_region_help: Drag the rectangle or its handles. The run measures a regular grid inside it.
bed.mode_points_help: Tap an empty spot of the bed to add a point, tap a point to select it, drag it to move it. The machine can only measure a regular grid, so the grid that holds your points is drawn for you.
bed.seed_tip: Takes every point of the grid shown now as a chosen point, so you can remove some.
bed.add_by_position: Add a point by its position
bed.mark_snapped: Chosen: the nearest node is measured
bed.mark_ignored: Chosen outside the reach: not measured
bed.points_help: Tap the bed to add a point. Keyboard: Tab to a point, Enter selects it, arrows move it (Shift: ten steps), Delete removes it, Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes.
bed.note_outside_area: That spot is outside what the probe can measure, so no point was added.
bed.note_outside_reach: That spot is outside the probe reach, so no point was added.
bed.note_limit: No more points: the limit is {n}.
bed.note_duplicate: There is already a point there.
bed.note_seed_big: The grid has {n} points and only {max} can be chosen. Make the region smaller first.
bed.note_set_dropped: {n} points of the set were outside this bed and were left out.
bed.grid_title: The grid that will be measured
bed.grid_none: No points chosen yet: the region is measured as it is. Tap the bed to choose points.
bed.grid_none_all_ignored: None of the chosen points can be measured (they are outside what the probe can reach). Remove them or choose others.
bed.grid_none_no_room: There is no room next to these points for the second row or column the machine needs.
bed.grid_summary: The run will measure {nodes} nodes ({nx} x {ny}), spaced {sx} x {sy} mm.
bed.grid_extra: {n} of them are not points you chose: the machine measures a full regular grid and cannot skip a node inside it, so they complete it.
bed.grid_padded: The machine needs at least 2 rows and 2 columns, so a row or a column was added next to your points.
bed.grid_merged: {n} nodes carry more than one chosen point (the same place): they are measured once.
bed.grid_exact: Every chosen point is on a node.
bed.grid_inexact_too_many: A grid that holds every point exactly would need {nodes} nodes ({nx} x {ny}), more than a run takes ({max}). The best grid that fits is used, so some points move to the nearest node.
bed.grid_inexact_no_common_spacing: No regular grid holds all the points at once: their distances do not line up. The best grid is used, so some points move to the nearest node.
bed.grid_snapped_title: Points that move to a node
bed.grid_snapped: Chosen at X {x}, Y {y}: measured at the node X {nx}, Y {ny}, {d} mm away.
bed.grid_ignored: Chosen at X {x}, Y {y}: outside what the probe can measure, so it is not used.
bed.set_err_empty: Write a name for the set.
bed.set_err_long: The name can have 40 characters at most.
bed.set_err_no_points: There are no points to save.
bed.set_err_full: There are already 40 sets: delete one first.
bed.set_err_conflict: Somebody else changed the sets at the same time: try again.
bed.sets_intro: Named sets of points (for example the corners) kept on this machine, shared by Mesh and Level.
bed.sets_save: Save the points as a set
bed.sets_nothing_to_save: There are no points to save.
bed.sets_read_only: Your role can load sets but not save or delete them.
bed.sets_too_big: This set has more points than this page takes ({max}).
bed.sets_off_no_store: Point sets are off: the service of this machine does not have the store for them yet (it needs the newer WorkshopService).
bed.sets_off_error: Point sets are off: the service did not answer.
bed.job_intro: Type the area of a job, or drag it on the bed, to see whether the head can go there, the probe can measure there and the mesh covers it. Nothing moves.
bed.job_invalid: Type the position and a width and a height above zero.
bed.job_verdict_unknown: Cannot tell yet: some limits are not known.
bed.fit_unknown_no_bed: The axis limits are not known.
bed.fit_unknown_no_reach: The probe reach is not known.
bed.fit_unknown_no_mesh: There is no mesh: plan one or run one.
bed.fit_mesh_source_result: Checked against the mesh on show (the last result).
bed.fit_mesh_source_plan: Checked against the mesh the plan would measure.
bed.fit_share: {pct} % of the job is inside the mesh.

modes.title: Machine modes
modes.intro: Choose which kinds of work this machine does. Only the modes you switch on get steps, macros and settings in the plugins. Switching a mode off never deletes its files.
modes.fff_about: Heated extruder printing. The 3D printing plugin follows this mode.
modes.alone_hint: This is the only mode you use, so there is nothing to configure. Switch on another one if you change heads on this machine.
modes.off_hint: Switched off: its files stay on the SD card, untouched.
modes.via_service: Saved in the machine profile (shared by every plugin and every screen).
modes.via_local: The service did not accept the change, so it is kept in this browser only. Ask a technician to save it for the whole machine.
modes.none_text: Select at least the modes you use. Until then the plugins do not show mode steps.
modes.files_note: Switching a mode off never deletes its macro or its settings file.
modes.needs_technician: Only a technician or an administrator can switch modes on or off.

workarea.title: Work area
workarea.intro: The part of the bed where the tool may work in each mode. The Work table draws it, the laser editor respects it and an origin outside it cannot be saved. It is measured by taking the tool by hand to two opposite corners, or typed.
workarea.read_only: Read only: saving the area or moving the tool needs the technician role.
workarea.mode_note: The area of {mode} is shown and changed. The mode in use now is {current}.
workarea.file_missing: There is no cutarea.g file yet: it is created when the first area is saved.
workarea.macros_missing: The corner macros are missing on the card (the Workbench plugin brings them): without them nothing can be measured or walked.
workarea.err_numbers: Type four numbers: X minimum and maximum, Y minimum and maximum.
workarea.err_small: The area is smaller than {min} mm on a side: it looks like a capture error.
workarea.err_outside: The area goes outside the travel of the axes ({reach}).
workarea.err_no_reading: The measurement did not leave a position. The reason is in the DWC console.
workarea.here_title: With the tool, using the jog
workarea.here_intro: Take the tool to the corner with the jog (any tool: laser, spindle, nozzle) and press the button: its position becomes the corner. Nothing moves.
workarea.err_not_homed_here: X and Y need a homing to know where the tool is.
workarea.saved_intro: Take the tool to a corner with the jog, save the position there, then to the opposite corner and save it too. Choose them here: nothing moves.
workarea.saved_none: There are no saved positions yet. Save them with the jog.
workarea.corners_intro: Two opposite corners of the area, with the tool. Measuring by hand releases X and Y (they have no force), you take the tool to the corner and the machine measures against the end stops; it ends with a homing of X and Y. Precision about ±0.4 mm.
workarea.release_hint: They lose their force and the position is lost. It asks for a confirmation.
workarea.released_note: X and Y are released. Take the tool to the corner, slowly, and press measure. Do not use the jog or other movement buttons: any movement enables them again by itself.
workarea.map_intro: Drag the handles or the rectangle to change the area, or draw a new one on the empty bed. A tap sets a corner or takes the tool to that point.
workarea.tool_goto_tip: With the laser off; it raises Z and lowers it on arrival.
workarea.map_legend_edit: Green dashed: the saved area. With handles: the one you are editing (the boxes above follow it).
workarea.mode_in_use: The mode the machine is in now.
workarea.fff_pointer_note: In FFF the tool is the nozzle (it may be hot): walking the area or taking it to a point raises Z 5 mm and moves it over the bed. Keep the way clear.
workarea.map_none: The travel of the axes is not known: the map cannot be drawn without it. Home the machine or check the M208 limits.
workarea.frame_intro: The tool walks the outline of the saved area, with the laser off, to see if it is the one you want.
workarea.frame_save_first: The saved area is walked: save the changes first.
workarea.block_loading: Reading the state of the machine…
workarea.block_macro_missing: The macro is missing on the card (the Workbench plugin brings it).
workarea.block_not_homed: X and Y must be homed first.
workarea.block_no_area: This mode has no saved area.
workarea.block_not_edited: The machine is not in {mode} mode: only the area of the mode in use is walked.
